$comment: Declarative contract for the version sites ISO 3166 tracks. Not yet read by check_version_consistency.py; the refactor that makes the check data-driven waits for ISO 10383's version to land, making three implementations (ISO 4217, ISO 3166, ISO 10383). Adopt the shape verbatim from iso4217/axes.json.

axes.name: registry
axes.comment: The registry data version. Single source of truth. Bumped on every release.

text.comment: The file is a single line containing only the version.

json_path.comment: Read a JSON file and return the value at the dotted path.

toml_section.comment: Read a TOML file and return the value of the named key.

python_regex.comment: Match a Python file with a regex that captures the version.

badge.comment: Match a shields.io badge on a markdown line.

first_released_heading.comment: Read CHANGELOG.md and return the version from the first '## [x.y.z]' heading.

parquet_footer.comment: Read the version from the Parquet file's key-value metadata.
